preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is a positive integer.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 2 * 10**5 and isinstance(N, int) for N, K in test_cases) and all(1 <= K <= N for N, K in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is the number of nodes (1 ≤ N ≤ 2e5) and K is the number of trees (1 ≤ K ≤ N).

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == N and all(0 <= a <= 10**9 and isinstance(a, int) for a in A) for A in A_lists)
preconditions.description: For each test case, A is a list of N node values (0 ≤ A_i ≤ 1e9).

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == N - 1 and all(isinstance(u, int) and isinstance(v, int) and 1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N and u != v for u, v in edges) for edges in edge_lists)
preconditions.description: For each test case, edges describe a tree with N-1 edges, where each edge connects two distinct nodes (1 ≤ u_i, v_i ≤ N).

preconditions.expression: sum(N for N, K, A, edges in test_cases) <= 2 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of N across all test cases does not exceed 2e5.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) and result >= 0 for result in results)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a non-negative integer representing the maximum possible bitwise AND of the XORs of node values in each of the K trees.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result <= (1 << 30) - 1 for result in results)
postconditions.description: The result is a valid bitwise AND of K integers, each of which is the XOR of some subset of node values (0 ≤ result ≤ 2^30 - 1).

postconditions.expression: all(any((all(node in tree for tree in partition) and len(partition) == K and all(isinstance(tree, set) for tree in partition) and all(len(tree) >= 1 for tree in partition) and sum(len(tree) for tree in partition) == N) and (result == (lambda B: B[0] & B[1] & ... & B[K-1])([xor(A_i for i in tree) for tree in partition])) for partition in possible_partitions) for result in results)
postconditions.description: The result is the maximum possible bitwise AND of the XORs of node values in each of the K trees, where the trees form a valid partition of the tree's nodes (each node in exactly one tree, K trees total).
